categories.nameEs: Cortes de Carne y Platos Principales

products.nameEs: Totopos y Salsa Casera de la Casa
products.descriptionEs: Nuestra famosa salsa fresca y crujientes totopos de maíz recién hechos. Una de las mejores de la región.
products.descriptionEn: Our famous signature fresh salsa served with warm, crispy corn tortilla chips. One of the best around.

products.descriptionEs: Queso melted al horno con auténtico chorizo mexicano, servido con tortillas de harina calientes.
products.descriptionEn: Melted cheese baked with authentic Mexican chorizo, served piping hot with warm flour tortillas.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante especial de la casa, acompañadas de aderezo ranch y apio.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our special house spicy sauce, served with ranch dressing and celery sticks.
Classic slow-roasted prime rib cooked to absolute perfection, served with au jus and a baked potato.
Juicy New York strip steak grilled to your liking with exceptional marbling and rich, robust flavor.
Tender and delicate filet mignon, optionally wrapped in bacon, served with seasonal vegetables.
Grilled steak and chicken strips sizzling with peppers and onions. Served with guacamole, sour cream, and warm tortillas.
Three shredded chicken enchiladas smothered in homemade red salsa, melted cheese, and fresh crema on top.
Massive burrito stuffed with tender carnitas, black beans, Mexican rice, pico de gallo, and warm cheese sauce.
Three crispy battered fish tacos topped with purple cabbage, chipotle crema, and fresh cilantro on corn tortillas.
Our signature margarita crafted with 100% blue agave tequila, Cointreau, and fresh lime juice.

products.nameEs: Margarita de Frutos Rojos y Jalapeño
products.descriptionEn: A vibrant blend of tequila, fresh muddled strawberries, spicy jalapeño kick, and a chili-salt rim.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos varias opciones marcadas en nuestro menú de carnes y antojitos mexicanos. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we feature several marked options across our steak and Mexican menus. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large parties?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con amplias áreas para grupos grandes. Recomendamos llamar con anticipación al (860) 429-1900, especialmente los fines de semana.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have large party areas to accommodate groups. We recommend calling ahead at (860) 429-1900, especially on weekends.

faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con un amplio estacionamiento gratuito junto al histórico edificio del granero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer ample complimentary parking right next to our historic converted barn building.
